name: execute_lua
arguments:
{"code":"local function route(grid, teleporters)
  local H = #grid
  local W = #grid[1]
  local NSTAT = H*W*4
  local function idx(r,c,k) return (r-1)*W*4+(c-1)*4+k end
  local distC, distA, done = {}, {}, {}
  for i=1,NSTAT do distC[i]=math.huge; distA[i]=math.huge; done[i]=false end
  local sr,sc
  for r=1,H do
    local row=grid[r]
    for c=1,W do
      if string.sub(row,c,c)=='S' then sr,sc=r,c end
    end
  end
  local s=idx(sr,sc,1)
  distC[s]=0; distA[s]=0
  local tpn=teleporters and #teleporters or 0
  for step=1,NSTAT do
    local bi=-1
    local bc, ba = math.huge, math.huge
    for i=1,NSTAT do
      if not done[i] then
        local ci=distC[i]
        if ci<bc or (ci==bc and distA[i]<ba) then bi=i; bc=ci; ba=distA[i] end
      end
    end
    if bi<0 then break end
    done[bi]=true
    if bc==math.huge then break end
    local keys=(bi-1)%4
    local t=math.floor((bi-1)/4)
    local c=t%W+1
    local r=math.floor(t/W)+1
    if string.sub(grid[r],c,c)=='G' then return {cost=bc,actions=ba} end
    local dirs={{1,0,'v'},{-1,0,'^'},{0,1,'>'},{0,-1,'<'}}
    for d=1,4 do
      local nr=r+dirs[d][1]; local nc=c+dirs[d][2]; local mv=dirs[d][3]
      if nr>=1 and nr<=H and nc>=1 and nc<=W then
        local cell=string.sub(grid[nr],nc,nc)
        local entry=1
        local ok=true
        if cell=='#' then ok=false
        elseif cell=='~' then entry=3
        elseif cell=='A' then if keys%2==0 then ok=false end
        elseif cell=='B' then if math.floor(keys/2)%2==0 then ok=false end
        end
        if ok then
          if cell=='>' then if mv~='>' then ok=false end
          elseif cell=='<' then if mv~='<' then ok=false end
          elseif cell=='^' then if mv~='^' then ok=false end
          elseif cell=='v' then if mv~='v' then ok=false end
          end
        end
        if ok then
          local nk=keys
          if cell=='a' then if keys%2==0 then nk=keys+1 end
          elseif cell=='b' then if math.floor(keys/2)%2==0 then nk=keys+2 end end
          local ns=idx(nr,nc,nk+1)
          local ncst=bc+entry
          if ncst<distC[ns] or (ncst==distC[ns] and ba+1<distA[ns]) then distC[ns]=ncst; distA[ns]=ba+1 end
        end
      end
    end
    for i=1,tpn do
      local tp=teleporters[i]
      if tp.fr==r and tp.fc==c then
        local cell=string.sub(grid[tp.tr],tp.tc,tp.tc)
        if cell~='#' then
          local ok=true
          if cell=='A' and keys%2==0 then ok=false end
          if cell=='B' and math.floor(keys/2)%2==0 then ok=false end
          if ok then
            local nk=keys
            if cell=='a' and keys%2==0 then nk=keys+1
            elseif cell=='b' and math.floor(keys/2)%2==0 then nk=keys+2 end
            local ns=idx(tp.tr,tp.tc,nk+1)
            local ncst=bc+tp.cost
            if ncst<distC[ns] or (ncst==distC[ns] and ba+1<distA[ns]) then distC[ns]=ncst; distA[ns]=ba+1 end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return {cost=-1, actions=-1}
end

local function fmt(x) return x.cost..','..x.actions end
local tests = {}
tests[#tests+1]='T1:'..fmt(route({'S~G','...'},{}))
tests[#tests+1]='T2:'..fmt(route({'S.A.G','#.###','a....'},{}))
tests[#tests+1]='T3a:'..fmt(route({'S#G','.#.','...'},{{fr=1,fc=1,tr=1,tc=3,cost=5}}))
tests[#tests+1]='T3b:'..fmt(route({'S#G','.#.','...'},{{fr=1,fc=1,tr=1,tc=3,cost=7}}))
tests[#tests+1]='T4:'..fmt(route({'S<G','...'},{}))
return table.concat(tests,';')"}

  if same('wood', 'stone') then return 'axe' end
  return 'none'
end)

  local v = t[i]
